title: Payroll notification

messages.text: Your payroll for period ending 11/15 has been processed. Amount: $3,247.82 deposited to account ending in 4891. View details in Employee Portal > Payroll or contact HR at ext. 3050.

⚠️ ALERT: Suspicious activity on your payroll account! Your last deposit is on HOLD pending verification. Click here immediately to confirm identity or funds will be returned: https://nexatrust-verify.com/urgent/login?emp=5829

explainPoints: Different sender name: 'NexaTrust Payroll' vs the legitimate 'NexaTrust HR'.
Suspicious number format: '+1-866-PAY-NOW' is unusual. Real company texts use short codes like '55512'.

Message content is alarming: The phishing message uses urgent language with symbols (⚠️), threats about funds being 'on HOLD', and demands immediate action. The legitimate message is calm, detailed, and informative.
Malicious link: nexatrust-verify.com is fake. Real payroll details are only in the Employee Portal.
